description: Decoder-track experiments for MTAH final_v5. Cached fold probabilities only; no refit, no manual labels. Adoption: bench up >=0.005 and ext/masked not down >0.005. Official scorer authoritative; public window never used to choose. venv interpreter used directly (no uv.lock mutation).

baseline.name: final_v5
baseline.model: HistGBDT 600 trees, mirrors + extra-noise copies (mtah/final.py MODEL)

adoption_rule: bench delta >= +0.005 AND ext delta >= -0.005 AND masked delta >= -0.005. Else rejected.

runs.name: duel-conditioned H/A switch cost
runs.hypothesis: Raise H<->A cost when >=1 home AND >=1 away within 2m (contested duel); loose ball stays last team.
runs.config: extra_team in {+1,+2,+4,+8} nats on duel frames (seen & nh2>=1 & na2>=1); stop_gate=100, min_dead=25 identical
runs.note: bench flat to slightly negative; spurious stays 3.6/100. decoder already conservative (pred/true 0.71). +0.011 val_h2 bump is the known eye-label trap, not adopted.

runs.name: cheaper alive<->dead cost (cost_dead=8)
runs.hypothesis: Recover short live spells; stop_gate already blocks stoppage spurious.
runs.note: errors/100 unchanged (missed 22.3, drift 19.4). No recovery of missed short spells.

runs.name: cost_dead=6
runs.note: worse on both ext and masked.

runs.name: boundary head w_bound=0.5
runs.note: ext up but masked down; net bench negative.

runs.name: boundary head w_bound=1.0
runs.note: Most informative: external-trained boundary conventions lift ext +0.004 but hurt masked our-match -0.005. Cross-track signal for sports/training: do NOT add boundary emission features without our-match calibration (learns external label conventions, per INVESTIGATION 22-23).

runs.hyp: dense frame-correspondence actual ball recovery (1941 frames)
runs.note: 533 label flips public but score unchanged; masked seed0 85/4523 overlap 0 diff; seed1 0 overlap

best.note: No decoder candidate cleared adoption bar. Decoder track plateaued; error taxonomy invariant across all transition-cost levers -> errors live in emissions, not smoothing. Best = v5 itself. NOT promoted to final; gates still required.

diagnostic: Across E3 + C1-C4 the per-100 error counts are flat: missed ~22, drift ~19, merge ~10.6, spurious ~3.6. Transition-cost levers cannot move the error mix. Missed short spells (<2s recall ~0.19) are an emission/model problem, owned by sports/training track.
